summary: Sampling as the MOSS-Image authors recommend: Euler, 50 steps, CFG 3, layer 22 skipped in the negative pass.
notes: Train on the Base build; SFT is a fine-tune of it.
The text encoder stays frozen, as the authors ask (ZenTrainer never trains it).
Around 1 megapixel or more: 1024² is the floor they recommend. Sides are multiples of 16.
CFG 3 suits long prompts; raise it toward 6 for short ones.
Skipping layer 24 or 26 instead of 22 also works. Turning skip-layer guidance off looks more realistic but can collapse details.
Shift 5 is ComfyUI's default for MOSS already.
